feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED. The candidate defines exactly the three declared propositions (blocker_moved, has_door_key, target_picked_up) with matching names, each taking only `env`, and no predicates for propositions the machine does not use (door_open, key_lost). blocker_moved scans the grid, guards every cell with `is not None` before reading attributes, and reports moved exactly when no ball sits on the start-side cell directly in front of the door (x-1), which covers pickup by the agent (ball leaves the grid), dropping it elsewhere, and turning false again when dropped back in front. has_door_key checks `env.carrying` for a key and requires its color to match an existing door found by a guarded scan, matching the declared meaning. target_picked_up checks that the carried object is a box and matches the mission string 'pick up the <color> box' built from `env.mission`, so no fixed color is assumed. All three read only the current observation, use only documented API surface (env.mission, env.carrying, env.grid.get, env.width, env.height) and allowed builtins (any, str, range), contain a single expression-only return, and perform no mutation or history access.
